verdict.rationale: RUN documents its own recurring automation for payroll: RUN & DONE puts recurring payroll on autopilot, and pay is deposited automatically on payday. This is a domain-specific recurring job rather than general-purpose scheduling of user-defined jobs or workflows. API Central offers integration building blocks but no scheduler. Missing for 10: user-defined scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows, configurable schedules or triggers beyond payroll, programmatic or AI-agent control of schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
